purpose: Handbook page for the Cijferen domain.
details: Explains the grid (carry row, numbers, line, result), the per-year tables for addition, subtraction and multiplication, the step-by-step long division and the cheat sheet. It follows the fixed work method of the main handbook page. Tables per school year and the list of thinking errors and the cheat sheet are generated by docs/tools/handleiding.py between auto markers; the screenshots show the 0.19 menus.
